trigger: Selected by parent after completed matched pair failed its predeclared comprehensive gain gate; no additional training is authorized by this diagnostic.
question: Is the learned multiplicative hash gate used by the fitted TRAIN fields, and is poor joint validation gain associated with near-saturated or weak modulation?

scope.selection: Same fixed TRAIN CADs used in the completed query-use diagnostic; chosen before current pair result.

checkpoints.endpoint: last.pt at fixed step10000, not validation-selected best
checkpoints.source: Completed fresh split-native matched pair; no old Composite checkpoint.

sampling.case_independence: Same CPU SeedSequence and fixed query/tet indices for all three known loads and both models; save hashes and exact source scheme.

counterfactual.natural: Keep trained actual/zero gate, same actual query/global context and parameters.
counterfactual.masked: Override only decoder.mode to zero, leaving all weights, inputs, context and nine-basis load combination unchanged; restore mode after forward.
counterfactual.zero_control: Natural and masked zero model predictions/loss must be identical within the explicit numerical check.
counterfactual.interpretation: Inference masking is out of training distribution; measures local use, not retrained-model performance or proof of the cause of generalization failure.

readouts.gamma: Mean/RMS of gamma-1, spatial-centered RMS, per-channel extrema/means, finite fraction, near endpoint fraction (gamma<=0.05 or>=1.95), exact endpoint fraction.
readouts.head: Trained W/b norms and exactzero policy for zero control; no optimizer or checkpoint modification.
readouts.u: Sampled case-balanced relative-case MSE on 12800 mixed queries, retaining original signed u and frozen training RMS/relative weights.
readouts.P1: Same physical-corner, volume-normalized squared Frobenius strain loss as earlier diagnostic; not the all-node recovered P1 relativeL2 percentage.
readouts.masked_effect: Natural vs masked losses on identical queries for all 12 TRAIN cases; ratio and number of cases harmed/helped, no causal or validation claim.

limits: TRAIN-only fixed small probe; not generalization, uncertainty or statistical-significance evidence.
Near-saturation is descriptive; cannot prove it caused poor validation.
The gate changes effective capacity and current pair uses a new native initialization; preserve those limits.
A simple feature gate and query distance pool do not implement FEM connectivity or solve elasticity.
next: Root uses this bounded evidence and current train/validation error to select one subsequent GeoBC task, with no automatic amplitude/radius/loss/width sweep.

parent_selection.decision: One frozen TRAIN gate-use diagnostic, no seed or gain/loss/radius sweep.
